disclaimer: All figures are simulated backtest, not real performance.

summary_window.note: KPIs recomputed on a common window so products are comparable; they differ from each ficha, which uses its own window.
summary_window.drawdown_note: max_dd_pct and mar use the drawdown published on each ficha: the harder of its monthly curve and the TradingView reading, never above the daily mark-to-market one. max_dd_daily_pct and mar_daily keep the daily mark-to-market reading. max_dd_source names which one applies.
summary_window.windows_note: kpis_by_window: each window ends at the product's last published candle; null when the product's history does not cover it.
